name: finta
description: Read and update your startup's books in Finta: financial reports, transactions, reconciliation, rules, tags, and tax filings.

interface.longDescription:
Finta is accounting software and done-for-you tax filing for US startups. Connect your Finta account to work with your company's books from ChatGPT: get the income statement, balance sheet, cash flow statement and key metrics such as burn and runway; search, categorize and bulk edit transactions; reconcile bank and card accounts; manage rules and tags; build Sheets with live actuals; and check tax filings and what Finta needs from you.

You sign in with your Finta account, so there is no API key to manage. The plugin can only see and do what your role in Finta allows. A Finta account is required.
defaultPrompt: What were our burn and runway last month?
Show me this month's uncategorized transactions.
Give me our income statement for this year.

positive.prompt: What's my company's legal name in Finta?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the connected company's legal name from Finta (Northwind Labs, Inc. in the test account), along with its display name and entity type.

positive.prompt: What's my financial burn last month?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns last month's net burn for the connected company from Finta's key metrics, matching the Burn row on the Finta dashboard.

positive.prompt: What's my most recent uncategorized transaction in Finta?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the latest transaction in Uncategorized Expenses with its merchant, amount, date and account.

positive.prompt: Can you categorize my most recent uncategorized transaction as a Meals expense?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the latest uncategorized transaction, sets its category to Meals (Finta's category for meal expenses) and confirms the change.

positive.prompt: Can you create a tag for me called "Offsite 2026"?
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a tag named Offsite 2026 and confirms it. If the tag already exists from an earlier run, it reuses that tag instead of creating a duplicate.

negative.description: Not about the company's books, so the plugin shouldn't be used.
negative.prompt: What's a good recipe for banana bread?

negative.description: Moving money is out of scope. Finta can't make payments, so the plugin should say so and not change any data.
negative.prompt: Can you pay our AWS bill from my Mercury account in Finta?

negative.description: Finta doesn't expose full bank account or routing numbers, so the plugin should say so and point the user to their bank.
negative.prompt: Can you show the full account and routing numbers for my Chase checking account?

publication.release_notes: Initial release: financial reports and key metrics, transaction search and categorization, reconciliation, rules, tags, Sheets, and tax filing status for your Finta company.
